works.body:
Hello. I think your artstyle is very cute, especially the character's eyes.
I would like to request an illustration.
The character is a Taekwondo character named Shion Aoyama.
She is a Taekwondo black belt who is cheerful and enthusiastic.
Reference: https://sta.sh/2fgrjkslirt

She will be sitting down and smiling while looking at the viewer. She will also be sweating as she is taking a break after some training.
Similar pose to this: https://sta.sh/0mky1uen7e5

Background can be a simple looking martial arts dojo with a blue mat.

I hope you have fun drawing her!

こんにちは、こんにちは！
私のVtuberを描いていただけませんか？濃い紫のオーバーサイズのセーターを着て、アイスコーヒーを手に持っている彼女を描いてください！

透明な背景を含めてください！

このアートは商品として商用利用されますが、もちろんクレジットは付与されます！
をご検討いただきありがとうございます！

https://twitter.com/Unortho_Foxx/status/1537529887795433472/photo/1

Hi, I'm Evaki, a VTuber!! @evakivt on Twitter
Your illustrations are so pretty, Nila recommended me to you!

I would like you to draw an illustration of me and my friend Nila in the outfits of VALORANT characters Yoru and Chamber! Please draw Nila in Chamber's outfit and Evaki in Yoru's outfit~

I will leave the poses and expressions up to you!

I will attach references for characters, outfits and poses in the link below!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bVdeI82w-_eJytiiY_s-hBUrWFDKCw9Y?usp=sharing

Hello! I'm Nila and I'm a VTuber!
I would love your art and would love to see my character in your art style!! 

Nila is a princess from the moon who has the power to control water on Earth. 
Her theme is blue roses, music and water!

I have attached a reference image in the link called "REF.png", it would be great if you could make an illustration like that of my character!!


https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dMlr5CBhMpqmnAalcjb0etHN7I-SqNIT

Hello! I really like your art and would like you to draw my FFXIV character! She is a cute and cheerful girl. Make her look cute! The pose and expression is up to you! 

Reference: https://imgur.com/a/nw2demm

Hello! Will you please draw my Vtuber character? Please give her white hair, and please include the axolotl hairpin! You can change her outfit if you like, as long as it fits the theme. She is petite and has a small frame.

For the pose, could you please draw her next to an aquarium of axolotls? She could be watching them, or feeding them pellets. Either pose is fine! 

Lastly, may I please have the .psd file? I would prefer it if the picture was landscape orientation 16:9. Also, may I please use this image commercially, such as for merchandise or on my stream? Thank you for considering my request!

https://imgbox.com/g/F6JQTixOWE

Hello! Here once again for your amazing and beautiful art! I would like to request some art for Mew Horizon. Could you draw her being cheeky with her tongue sticking out like she did something naughty. Also could you draw her in her first outfit without the added on dress just in her casual clothes. Thank you!!!~
Mew Horizon Reference: https://twitter.com/mew_horizon/status/1503410461223813124?s=21&t=WbrURyyvmS2QF5W-GM73Dw

Hello! Your art is beautiful! I would like to request an artwork from you for my original Vtuber character. ^-^ 

My character's name is Lilica. She is a hooded-crow Vtuber. She is 5 feet 6 inches tall. Her personality is cheerful and sweet. She loves to have fun. Her main features are her 2 small wings on her back, 2 small fangs in her mouth, hair pin, necklace, and thigh accessory.

I leave the pose, expression, and background composition to the artist. Please enjoy illustrating my character in your own art style and interpretation. I hope it can show how pretty and playful Lilica can be with bright colors.

Please sign on a separate layer and provide the .psd transparent files, if possible.

Thank you for your time and consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/NMc9xLm
